generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course applies to the work you are already doing. Every module you take designs its sessions, marks your work against criteria, and gives you feedback; the students who see that cycle, and work with it on purpose, are the ones whose work improves from one task to the next. Treat what follows as being about your own essays, reports and assignments, not about study in the abstract.

The same design, standard and feedback cycle runs in most professional work. You are given a task, it is judged against a standard, you receive feedback, and you carry it into the next task. Working with that cycle, rather than guessing at it, is a habit you keep long after you graduate.
